title: Great for sitting room
text: Great for sitting room. We have 2 cats w/claws and 2 pleather couches. Couches were in rough condition when we purchased. Wanted covers to hide cat scratches - we've tried everything to make them stop, no luck. They scratch the less with these covers since their claws get stuck and they hate it. Their scratching hasn't ripped or put holes in the fabric at all, very surprised! The little foam pieces that come with the covers were lost long ago. When you utilize the couches the covers slip and bring out the foam pieces that are meant to keep it looking tidy. We use these in our sitting room upstairs which isn't used too often. Great for the cheap, aesthetic, reason we purchased.
